about: Proposed region definitions for detailed maps of Thailand: 76 provinces and Bangkok, with Bangkok and its five neighbouring provinces as the worked example. A proposal for discussion (docs/REGIONS-TH.md); no code reads this file, and it does not ship. Sources are national or global, so they are listed once under country_layers, and each region points there.

codes.why: The two digits are the Ministry of Interior province code that Thai datasets already use, and no bare two-letter code is needed, so nothing collides with a US state in STATE_CODES (engine/address_search.py).
codes.verified: Read from Wikipedia's copy and from the shapeISO field of geoBoundaries' province file. The ISO site refused automated reading and was not checked.

layer_keys.crops: crops.sqlite (land cover, since no usable crop map was found)

terrain.publisher: European Space Agency / Airbus Defence and Space
terrain.notes: 30 m surface model. No open national elevation model was found.

water.dataset: Water layers (natural water bodies, reservoirs, weirs, dams, flood areas, gauging stations)
water.verified: file lists read; attributes not read
water.notes: Shapefiles dated September 2018; the dam layer has about 1,087 points, worked out from the index file's size.

buildings.notes: Also offered under ODbL. Thailand is in the country list; no count read.
142 Thailand files in the index of 13 August 2026, about 1.84 GB compressed.

places.dataset: Subdistrict centre points with Thai and romanised names
places.notes: 7,769 rows with visible duplicates; record last modified 2021.

places.publisher: OCHA, from the Royal Thai Survey Department

addresses.notes: Overture's address theme covers 41 countries and not Thailand; data.go.th has no address points; OSM has 70,470 objects with a house number in Thailand.

pois.publisher: Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation
pois.notes: About 10,976 rows with coordinates, capacity, power, water and toilets; Bangkok coverage not checked.
Has coordinates, some blank; record dated 2021.

pois.dataset: Bangkok hospitals, fire stations, police stations, schools, pumping stations, floodgates, flood risk points
pois.notes: All have coordinates; none states a licence.

addressing.levels: Province (changwat); district (amphoe, or khet in Bangkok); subdistrict (tambon, or khwaeng in Bangkok); village number (moo) in rural areas.
addressing.order: House number and road, then subdistrict and district, then province and postcode ("491 Rangsit-Nakhon Nayok 4 Road, Prachathipat / Amphoe Tanyaburi, Pathumthani / 12130").

postal_code.format: Five digits after the province; the leading part stands for the province, the rest for the post office

addressing.notes: House numbers can hold a slash (10/42). Addresses are written in Thai script or in Latin letters with inconsistent spelling. Years in datasets are in the Buddhist era (subtract 543). engine/address_search.py already reads a five-digit postcode and a number before the street; it would need the slash, Thai script, and the soi and moo words.

bbox_source.method: Extent of every vertex of the province polygon in the full-resolution GeoJSON; margin is 0.15 degrees, rounded outward to 0.01.
